outages.headline: From products to crude: how the strikes reshaped Russia’s seaborne exports
outages.summary: From products to crude: how the strikes reshaped Russia’s seaborne exports Ukraine’s strikes on Russian ports and refineries stepped up sharply after March 2026, and the effect on Russia’s seaborne oil trade was not really a simple fall in volumes. What changed was the mix. Refined product exports out of the Baltic terminals fell apart, ...
